subject: Procurement intake — vendor portal preference & payment path confirmation
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps + procurement checklist after today’s demo

Hi Clara — great to meet you and Linda on the call today. Quick recap and the items we discussed so your procurement team has what they need to move forward.

What we covered
- Demo highlights: streaming generation, per-route cost breakdowns, and private deployment options.
- Commercial paths: Hosted API (card), Dedicated (PO / committed), Marketplace listing if you prefer SaaS procurement.
- Paperwork: Acme requires vendor packet + tax form (W-9/W-8) and banking details for ACH.

Action items for Acme (please confirm):
1) Which buying path will you use? (PO / corporate card / marketplace)
2) Vendor portal vs email intake — which is preferred for vendor setup?
3) Procurement contact for paperwork (name, email, phone).
4) Any specific vendor packet fields we should pre-fill (e.g., remit-to, tax id).

What I can send this week
- Redwood vendor packet (fillable PDF) -> I can pre-fill company name and remit-to if you want.
- Redwood W-9 (if you're US tax only) or W-8 if international.
- A short commercial summary and SOW excerpt for your vendor packet.

Please loop Linda or your procurement contact into this thread and confirm whether you prefer a PO or card path — that determines whether we need a formal vendor onboarding through your portal or just billing card setup.

Thanks — I’ll get the draft packet over once I have the procurement contact.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0139

From: Clara Nguyen <clara@acmehealth.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Linda Park <procurement@acmehealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps + procurement checklist after today’s demo

Thanks Mateo — good session. Looping Linda (procurement) as requested. Quick answers from our side: 

- Buying path: Our default is PO for any SaaS subscriptions > $25k ARR. We expect this to go as a PO to start (likely annual).
- Portal vs email: We prefer our vendor portal (VendorCentral). Linda will upload vendor documents via the portal, but she needs the packet in the vendor packet template and a PDF of your W-9.
- Procurement contact: Linda Park (procurement@acmehealth.ai) — she handles vendor onboarding and payments.
- Special fields: We will need your legal entity name, EIN, remit-to address, and banking instructions for ACH.

Can you send the vendor packet in our template and the W-9? Also please indicate if Redwood supports Net-30 terms (we typically pay Net-30 once vendor is set up).

Clara
Director, Product Ops | Acme Health
clara@acmehealth.ai

Subject: Redwood vendor packet + W-9 (draft) — please confirm portal fields

Hi Linda and Clara — Monica from Redwood CS here. Mateo asked me to start the vendor packet so you can upload to VendorCentral. Attached is a pre-filled draft that includes our legal entity information and suggested remit-to.

What’s attached
- redwood-vendor-packet.pdf (fillable, pre-filled with Redwood legal + remit-to)
- W-9_RedwoodInference.pdf (our tax form for US vendors)

A few notes for the portal upload
- Field mapping: our EIN (12-3456789) goes in Tax ID / EIN field; legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; remit-to: Redwood Inference, 220 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105.
- Payment terms: we support Net-30 by default for enterprise PO customers; if Acme needs a deviation we can discuss with finance.
- Banking details: we provide ACH instructions after vendor setup (we redact full account details until the portal accepts the packet). If VendorCentral requires an ACH form, let me know and I’ll provide the bank form as a separate PDF.

Linda — if you prefer, I can also fill Acme’s vendor template (send the template as an attachment) — we have historically uploaded both our packet and the buyer's template so their portal ingestion is smooth.

Next steps for Redwood
1) Confirm preferred vendor template (if you have one) so we can populate it.
2) Once you confirm, we’ll return a signed MSA (DocuSign link) and the vendor packet in your format.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

Hi Clara / Linda — following up to close out paperwork so we can get you onboarded. Attached: filled vendor packet in Acme's template (acme_vendor_form_filled.pdf) plus our W-9 and the Redwood vendor packet.

Quick summary and asks:
- Buying path confirmed: PO (per Clara) — Redwood can accept PO and set Net-30 terms. I’ve cc’d Vanessa (billing ops) to coordinate invoicing and remit-to verification.
- Portal upload: Monica pre-filled core fields; acme_vendor_form_filled.pdf is formatted for VendorCentral. Please confirm once it’s uploaded so we can enable billing.
- DocuSign: Here’s the MSA link for signature — https://www.docusign.com/en/link/msasign-acme-2027. Once signed we can issue the first invoice.
- Banking/ACH: Vanessa will follow up (private thread) to get secure remit/ACH instructions if VendorCentral requires them.

Next steps (timeline):
1) Linda uploads packet to VendorCentral (today/this week).
2) Acme signs MSA via DocuSign (Linda/Clara).
3) Redwood issues initial invoice and enables the account once vendor is active.

If there are any missing fields in the attached form, let me know and I’ll patch and resend. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Linda if that speeds the portal ingestion.

Thanks,
